interpretation.quality_comparison: Descriptive matched-input geometric success/length comparison is supported: same endpoint tasks, geometry, validation/configuration, roadmap bytes and shared dependency bytes, plus fresh LSCS anchor reproduction. Label old paper methods as historical sealed observations; do not relabel as a single simultaneously executed same-source experiment.
interpretation.timing_comparison: Historical cold/warm timings may be shown with their source-study label and denominator. Source wrappers/dependency probes and execution times differ, so historical timings do not establish a clean causal speedup. Prefer fresh LSCS for same-runtime timing against RRTConnect. Offline DRM build costs stay separate; RRTConnect uses no roadmap.
interpretation.objective_separation: RRTConnect returns geometric polygon paths and does not solve minimum-time trajectory planning. Never compare its radian length directly with SCSTO/NTO-time durations in seconds. LSCS/LGCS and NTO-distance can be compared by the shared numerical path-length evaluation; exact represented curve/PWL details remain method-specific.
interpretation.conditional_cost_caution: Do not rank means over each method’s own successes. Use common-success pairs and retain all 180 legal attempts for success rate. NTO-distance succeeds only on 35 straight-line-free observations; its low unconditional successful-path mean reflects selection.
interpretation.source_change_review: Compared e6b7e372 to3414dd08: shared csdecomp_baseline.py changes add method registry, dependency branches, independent OMPL path, local optimizer branches and status metadata. Existing DRM/EI-ZO/LSCS body is unchanged. Model, validator, native handoff, paper NTO, SCS and LGCS source hashes in frozen inventories unchanged. Seven shared orchestration/config-loading/statistics files changed. This supports continuity, not identical whole runtime code.
interpretation.unresolved: One fresh LSCS recovery-path result differs slightly in recovered regions and objective despite identical input/seed/DRM path. No rerun or tuning performed for this analysis. Finite validation is not a continuous collision-free proof.
